channel.title: The Bridge India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Bridge India (thebridge.in)

item.title: All you need to know about the 2025 Squash World Cup in Chennai
item.description: India begins its campaign in Group B against Switzerland as Chennai hosts the World Cup for the third straight edition.

item.title: AIFF receives single bid from Capri Sports for Indian Women’s League commercial rights
item.description: The lone proposal will now be evaluated by AIFF’s bid committee before final approval in the coming days.

item.title: Guwahati Masters 2025: Sanskar Saraswat wins men's singles title; Tanvi Sharma loses
item.description: Sanskar defeated the experienced compatriot Mithun Manjunath in the final.

item.title: Men's Junior Hockey World Cup 2025 LIVE: India takes on Germany in semifinal- Blogs, updates
item.description: India face defending champions Germany in the Junior Hockey World Cup semifinal after a dramatic win over Belgium. Follow live updates from Chennai.

item.title: SAFF Women’s Club Championship 2025: East Bengal target winning start in maiden campaign
item.description: The IWL champions open their first SAFF campaign on Monday after a landmark AFC Women’s Champions League run.

item.title: ISSF World Cup Final: Simranpreet Brar stuns Olympic Champion to win gold
item.description: She also equalled the junior World Record of 41 hits out of 50 shots in the women's 25m sports pistol final.

item.title: Telangana outlines Olympic Mission 2036 and major sports investment push at Sports Tech Podium 2025
item.description: Jayesh Ranjan says the State aims to field athletes in every Olympic sport India competes in when the nation hosts the 2036 Games.

item.title: Mumbai Smashers complete fairytale surge to claim Indian Pickleball League title
item.description: Mumbai defeated Hyderabad Royals 5–1 in the final to lift the IPBL crown after entering the playoffs from sixth place.

item.title: Men’s Hockey Junior World Cup 2025: India falls to Germany, third straight last-four exit against European giants
item.description: Anmol Ekka scored India’s lone goal as Germany produced a dominant semifinal display in Chennai.

item.title: FC Goa edge East Bengal on penalties to retain AIFF Super Cup title
item.description: Goa won 6–5 in a tense shootout after a goalless 120 minutes, becoming the first team to defend the Super Cup crown.
